title: How to find the secret jet ski dog in GTA 6 🐕
description:
Credit: LIRIK (Twitch) https://www.twitch.tv/lirik/clip/ReliablePowerfulOilBatChest-ydNija0st6UB0byp
A dog on a jet ski called Cool Dog is hidden in GTA 6. How to find him:
1. Take a boat out into Gambit Bay.
2. Jump into the water and swim away from the boat.
3. Keep swimming for about 5 minutes, away from land and other boats.
4. When Cool Dog rides up on his jet ski, climb on and stay on until he reaches his island.
5. Throw him a ball and follow him around the island.
Then he digs up a hidden stash worth $1,200.

Would you get on the jet ski with him? 👇

Sources: GamesFuze, Insider Gaming (checked 26 Nov 2026). Narration: AI voice.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Gameplay credit: LIRIK.

title: How to find Bigfoot in GTA 6 🦶
description:
Credit: Kai Cenat (Twitch) https://www.twitch.tv/kaicenat/clip/BoldEncouragingHamJonCarnage-pe0Q59lJ1Zj-4lUY
GTA 6 has its own Bigfoot: the Skunk Ape, hiding in the swamps. How to find him (Kirk's first side mission):
1. Read Kirk's Skunk Ape flyer at Skeeter's bar in Hamlet, then call him.
2. Meet Kirk in the swamp near Pelican River - it only starts at night.
3. Turn on your flashlight and follow his drone.
4. Search the area for claw marks, then chase the Skunk Ape.
5. Survive the giant boar on the way back to Kirk's truck.
Then Kirk pays you $1,000.

Would you chase Bigfoot through a swamp at night? 👇

Sources: GTABase, eGamers (checked 26 Nov 2026). Narration: AI voice.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Gameplay credit: Kai Cenat.
